title: Ponderous
html:
Quest Giver: Colonel Cabo

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Go to Purpose-Pondering Peak off Level 7 of MutantMania. Punch-out Ensign Eviscerate and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Colonel Cabo

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Report to Commissioner Dumas

Zone: Mutant Mania

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Purpose-Pondering Peak off Level 7 of MutantMania. Punch-out Ensign Eviscerate and then report back to Colonel Cabo in the MutantMania Training Center.

Offer:

Your crowds...Ah say, your crowds are at an all-time low. Hopefully, you learned something from Logan the Liger that will help keep your career from falling too much further. Regardless, Ah have to book you in some less classy fights against some even tougher opponents. Go back to Purpose-Pondering Peak. Ensign Eviscerate is on the bill as the good guy. You're playing his crummy victim.

Turn-in:

Friend, you did well in the Purpose-Pondering Peak. But don't let that go to your head. It's a hard road to the top. Of the peak, that is. It's a joke, friend. You missed it.

Objectives:

  • Punch-out Ensign Eviscerate

Client level range: 88–100
